title: Prompt-enhanced Network for Hateful Meme Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance (Accuracy and Macro-F1) in a binary classification task to detect hateful vs. non-hateful multimodal memes using the FHM and HarM datasets. These datasets encompass bias and hate speech targeting race, gender, religion, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, and COVID-19-related demographics.
